# Agent Python Tools

- repo_uri: https://github.com/facebookresearch/omni3d

## File: facebookresearch_omni3d/cubercnn/modeling/meta_arch/rcnn3d.py

Prompts

```
['build a 3D cuboid detection model from a Detectron2 config using build_model', 'build a backbone network from config using build_backbone for the RCNN3D model', 'run 3D object detection inference on batched image inputs with camera intrinsics', 'run the training forward pass of RCNN3D to compute proposal and detector losses', 'visualize 2D bounding boxes and 3D cuboid predictions during RCNN3D training']
```

Usage

```
{'build_RCNN3D_model': 'build a 3D cuboid detection model from a Detectron2 config using build_model', 'build_RCNN3D_backbone': 'build a backbone network from config using build_backbone for the RCNN3D model', 'run_RCNN3D_inference': 'run 3D object detection inference on batched image inputs with camera intrinsics', 'run_RCNN3D_training_forward': 'run the training forward pass of RCNN3D to compute proposal and detector losses', 'visualize_RCNN3D_training': 'visualize 2D bounding boxes and 3D cuboid predictions during RCNN3D training'}
```
